card.name: Words inside all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Short words and word endings in ALL-CAPS boxed-warning text, such as the 1 in HIV-1, AS, WAS, AND, WHEN, IS, WITH. It responds to the capitalised style, not to one particular word.

modes.label: HIV-1 in capitals
modes.description: The number 1 after HIV- in capitalised warning titles about pre-exposure prophylaxis.

modes.label: Linking words in capitals
modes.description: Small connecting words like AS, WAS, AND, WHEN, IS, WITH inside capitalised warning sentences.
modes.example: BUT RATES<< AS>> HIGH AS 70% HAVE BEEN

modes.label: Capitalised word endings
modes.description: The ending of a capitalised drug-resistance term.
modes.example: EMERGENCE OF LAMIVUDINE-RESIST<<ANT>> HBV AND EXACERBATIONS

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward more capital-letter pieces such as PR, SE and TR, so the all-caps style continues.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in the all-caps warning paragraphs of drug labels.
